STRAIGHT ANSWERS

A good place
to start.

All questions & answers
What can Isak Fire Protection help with?

The team supports commercial, industrial and residential properties across nine fire protection disciplines. Explore the service directory, then contact Isak to confirm availability for your property.

Which locations do you serve?

The website lists Chicago, Toronto, Detroit, Dayton, Indianapolis and Milwaukee, serving Illinois, Ontario, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. Confirm the service scope for your address with the local team.

How often should my systems be inspected?

Inspection and testing schedules vary by system, component, adopted code, manufacturer and local authority. Ask Isak to review the requirements that apply to your property and create an appropriate schedule.

Do you work on new construction and retrofits?

Yes. Isak describes support for new construction, existing-building retrofits, system expansions and tenant improvements, including coordination with architects and general contractors.

Do you work with property management portfolios?

Yes. The published offering includes portfolio reporting, consolidated invoicing and account coordination for property and facility managers. Ask the team to confirm the services for your locations.
